environment.subagent_runtime: Hermes delegated tasks; each arm got an independent context
environment.measurement_caveat: Hermes did not expose per-subagent prompt token totals. Tool-result characters are a lower-bound proxy, not model context usage; transcript logs truncate some oversized tool outputs. Elapsed time and tool-call counts are transcript-derived; worker narrative effort estimates differed and are not used as measurements.

with_athenactx.outcome: Produced a grounded CLI-to-scanner flow and subsystem/limitations summary. Indexed the workspace and used targeted implementation retrieval. The Python project_cli.py scan returned language=unknown / no symbols, so the agent fell back to reading that source directly.

without_athenactx.outcome: Produced a similarly grounded CLI-to-scanner flow and subsystem/limitations summary by reading source/tests directly.

understanding.comparison: No observed time or tool-output reduction for the AthenaCtx arm in this run. AthenaCtx gave useful navigation on Shaft and the Tree-sitter bridge, but the unsupported project_cli.py scan and extra failed/empty index lookups offset that advantage.

with_athenactx.outcome: Identified that a cached False hit fails to refresh OrderedDict recency, causing A to be evicted and reloaded. Proposed an unconditional move_to_end(key) on cache hits.

without_athenactx.outcome: Identified the same LRU recency bug and proposed an unconditional recency refresh on hits.

bugfix.comparison: Both arms diagnosed and fixed the seeded LRU defect. AthenaCtx added 12.87 seconds and 4 tool calls in this single run; it did not show an effort reduction.

with_athenactx.outcome: Solved the simple false-value cache miss; initial relative-path scans failed and the agent recovered using explicit paths.

without_athenactx.outcome: Solved the same simple false-value cache miss by direct source inspection.

bugfix_pilot.comparison: Retained as an initial smoke-test pilot; not used as the primary hard-bug result.
